title: 所谓幸运
slug: 高能二维码全本免费-高能二维码最新章节列表
content_zh:
邢烨暗暗容就是方才黑白魔方上提示的个人信息。
二维码在生活中主要用于信息、链接、广告、推送、支付等方面，文字信息最多能够储存四五百字，他手机中生成的二维码是玩家在这个异空间内的基本资料，而梦境中回想起来的则更类似于链接。
目前邢烨能够推测到的内容只有这些，至于这里究竟是什么世界，弟弟的死是否与这个世界有关，还需要参与到游戏中慢慢调查。
他始终不相信弟弟邢烁是自然死亡，直觉告诉邢烨，他在这里能够查出真相。
既然如此，就需要积极参与游戏了。邢烨将视线从手机屏幕转移到黑白魔方上，问道：“你刚才提到阵营，是否代表将要进行的游戏是PVP模式？”
黑白魔方回答道：“没错，所有世界都是对战模式，根据新人保护原则，第一个世界普遍为初级世界，参加人数限定4人。”
说罢，黑白魔方没有再给邢烨询问的机会，魔方上出现几行字：
游戏内容：改写既定结局
玩家角色：执行者
参与人数：顺命阵营3人，逆命阵营1人
获胜方式：玩家分为操纵者与执行者，操纵者设计故事结局，执行者为故事主角，若故事最后结局为操纵者最先设定的结局，则操纵者获胜，反之为执行者。
奖惩内容：胜利阵营每人获得100积分，失败阵营扣除50%积分，胜利阵营可获得特殊二维码卡一张
注：参与人数与阵营立场均为系统随机抽取，如有异议，向自己的幸运值抱怨去吧！
邢烨只来得及看过基本信息，身体就被一股强大的吸力抽离黑白空间，意识大约出现了0.1-0.3秒的空白，再次集中意识时，他已经来到了一个从未见过的村庄。
这里景色很好，树木繁茂，空气清新，比邢烨去过的天然氧吧还好。
但房屋简陋，住户稀少，邢烨所处的院子中农具极其落后，看来还停留在生产力低下的农耕时代。
木屋的门开着，没有其他人居住的痕迹，他目前的身份应该是独居。
邢烨走进破旧到透风却打扫得十分干净的房屋中，查看一圈后，第一次切身体会到什么叫“家徒四壁”。
整个屋子里只有数量为一的木盆和木桶，一张干草铺成的床，床头上放着半块干硬的黑面包。
确认过周围环境暂且可以称之为安全后，邢烨开始检查自己身上的物资，手机不见了，取而代之的是手腕上戴着一个半黑半白的手环，他现在看起来也不像是富有到可以佩戴手镯的人，这件首饰必有问题。

邢烨仔细看向手环，果然发现一个透明的按钮，点击后虚空中便出现一个面板。
面板上只有两个图标是亮着的，邢烨按下第一个“故事背景”图标。
一个声音忽然在他脑海中出现：“很久很久以前，有位美丽的女王，她是全国最美的女人，美到每个看到她的人都忍不住低下头，不敢直视她那绝世容颜。
可惜上天是那么吝啬，不肯让这样的美好停留在人间。女王在一次狩猎中被熊抓瞎了一只眼睛，伤愈后，她绝望地发现自己受伤的半边脸变得扭曲丑陋。
从此以后，女王每次看到镜子就会歇斯底里地大吼，像疯了一般伤害自己。她无法接受自己的丑陋，打碎了皇宫、乃至全国所有的镜子。
无论贵族还是平民，都不允许拥有镜子。一旦有谁私藏镜子被军队发现，就会被处死。
克莱尔，一个平民女孩，她从未照过镜子，没见过自己的容貌。当她从村口老人的故事中知道这个国家曾经有镜子这样神奇的存在时，她十分希望拥有一面属于自己的镜子。”
邢烨：“……”
他自环境变幻后就一直在尽全力忽视胸前的异样感，甚至未曾低头观察过自己的身体和穿着，只当胸前沉甸甸的感觉是生了肿块，可听到故事主角是个女孩时，他实在无法继续欺骗自己了。
邢烨没有去确认身体性别，默默回想了一下背景后，又点开第二个图标——任务提示。
依旧是回荡在脑海中的声音：“任务一：玩家需维持角色设定，不能被NPC怀疑真实身份；任务二：阻止操纵者设定的三种结局（结局在故事开始已经设定，过程中操纵者不可改变）。”

content_en:
Xing Ye's dark appearance was the personal information shown on the black and white Rubik's Cube just now.
QR codes are mainly used in life for information, links, advertising, push, payment, etc. Text messages can store up to four to five hundred words. The QR code generated on his phone is the player's basic information in this alien space, while the ones recalled in dreams are more similar to links.
At present, this is all Xing Ye can guess. As for what kind of world this is and whether his brother's death is related to this world, he still needs to participate in the game and slowly investigate.
He never believed that his younger brother Xing Shuo died of natural causes, and his intuition told Xing Ye that he could find out the truth here.
In this case, you need to actively participate in the game. Xing Ye shifted his attention from the mobile phone screen to the black and white Rubik's Cube and asked: "You just mentioned the camp, does it mean that the game to be played is a PVP mode?"
Black and White Rubik's Cube replied: "Yes, all worlds are in battle mode. According to the principle of newcomer protection, the first world is generally a junior world, and the number of participants is limited to 4 people."
Having said that, the black and white Rubik's Cube did not give Xing Ye another chance to ask, and a few lines of words appeared on the Rubik's Cube:
Game content: Rewrite the established ending
Player role: Executor
Number of participants: 3 people from the obedient camp, 1 person from the anti-fate camp
Winning method: Players are divided into manipulators and executors. The manipulator designs the ending of the story, and the executor is the protagonist of the story. If the final ending of the story is the ending first set by the manipulator, the manipulator wins, otherwise the executor wins.
Reward and punishment content: Each person in the winning camp will receive 100 points, and 50% of the points will be deducted from the losing camp. The winning camp will receive a special QR code card.
Note: The number of participants and camp positions are randomly selected by the system. If you have any objections, just complain to your lucky score!
Xing Ye only had time to read the basic information before his body was pulled out of the black and white space by a strong suction force, and his consciousness went blank for about 0.1-0.3 seconds. When he concentrated his consciousness again, he had arrived at a village he had never seen before.
The scenery here is very good, with lush trees and fresh air, which is better than the natural oxygen bar Xing Ye has been to.
However, the houses are simple, there are few residents, and the farm tools in the yard where Xing Ye lives are extremely backward. It seems that it is still stuck in the farming era of low productivity.
The door of the wooden house was open, and there were no signs of anyone else living there. His current status should be that he lives alone.
Xing Ye walked into the dilapidated but drafty but very clean house. After looking around, he experienced for the first time what it means to be "a house with four walls".
There were only a few tubs and barrels in the whole house, a bed made of hay, and half a piece of dry, hard black bread on the bedside.
After confirming that the surrounding environment was safe for the time being, Xing Ye began to check his belongings. His mobile phone was missing, replaced by a half-black and half-white bracelet on his wrist. He didn't look like a rich enough person to wear a bracelet. There must be something wrong with this piece of jewelry.
Xing Ye looked at the bracelet carefully and found a transparent button. After clicking it, a panel appeared in the void.
Only two icons were lit on the panel, and Xing Ye pressed the first "Story Background" icon.
A voice suddenly appeared in his mind: "A long time ago, there was a beautiful queen. She was the most beautiful woman in the country. She was so beautiful that everyone who saw her could not help but lower their heads and did not dare to look directly at her peerless face.
It's a pity that God is so stingy and refuses to let such beauty stay in the world. The Queen was blinded in one eye by a bear during a hunt. After recovering from the injury, she desperately found that the injured half of her face had become distorted and ugly.
From then on, the Queen would yell hysterically and hurt herself like crazy every time she looked in the mirror. Unable to accept her own ugliness, she broke all the mirrors in the palace and throughout the country.
Neither nobles nor commoners were allowed to own mirrors. Once someone has privateIf a hidden mirror is discovered by the army, he will be executed.
Claire, a common girl, has never looked in the mirror or seen her own face. When she learned from the story of the old man at the entrance of the village that this country once had such a magical existence as a mirror, she really wanted to have a mirror of her own. "
Xing Ye: "..."
Ever since the environment changed, he had been trying his best to ignore the strange feeling on his chest. He had never even lowered his head to observe his body and clothes. He only thought that the heavy feeling on his chest was a lump. But when he heard that the protagonist of the story was a girl, he really couldn't continue to deceive himself.
Xing Ye did not confirm the gender of his body. After silently recalling the background, he clicked on the second icon - task prompt.
The voice still echoing in my mind: "Task 1: Players need to maintain their character settings and not be suspected by NPCs of their true identity; Task 2: Prevent the three endings set by the manipulator (the endings are set at the beginning of the story and cannot be changed by the manipulator during the process). "
